name: describe
description: Describes one TASK as its card, a board card by key, the vault as its shape card (`vault: true`, ARCH-0070), a task highway handle as its status (`after` polls it; `workflow`: its bound try), or the whole TASKS section when nothing is named.
call: if input.self_target { Err(MemoryError::bad_request("describe(self) requires a bound run session"))? } else if input.vault { memory.describe_vault(&input)? } else if input.key.is_some() { Err(MemoryError::bad_request("describe(card key) expands a board card, which only a live board session holds"))? } else if input.fold.is_some() { Err(MemoryError::bad_request("describe(fold) peeks at a fold of a run's own log, which only that run's code mode holds"))? } else if input.handle.is_some() || input.after.is_some() { crate::task_verb::sdk::describe_handle_status(memory, &input)? } else { memory.describe(input.task_ref.as_deref().map(crate::EntityId::from_hex).transpose()?)? }
